title: ALMA observations of the kinematics and chemistry of disc formation
question: Is there a Keplerian disc around the Class 0/I protostar IRS7B in the R CrA cloud, and how does the disc relate to the presence of complex organic molecules in the inner envelope?

what.value: Envelope model (r^-1.5 density, 2.2 Msun mass) adopted for CH3OH modelling

evidence.quote: The envelope model of (cite: lindberg12) was adopted.
CH$_3$OH collision rates from the LAMDA database were used (cite: lamda; rabli10).

what.value: Bolometric temperature 89 K and Lbol/Lsmm 48 for IRS7B

evidence.quote: The bolometric temperature is 89 K, and the bolometric/submillimetre luminosity ratio is 48

recipe.goal: Continuum point-source fluxes and disc masses
recipe.method: Fit point sources in continuum; disc mass from optically thin dust emission
assumptions: Optically thin, T_dust = 30 K, distance 130 pc

recipe.method: Fit strongest peak per channel in uv data, derive PA and PV diagram
key_parameters: PA -65 deg, centre LSR velocity 6.2 km/s

recipe.goal: Fit Keplerian disc with finite radius vs infall
recipe.method: Fit Keplerian profile plus linear branch; compare chi2 with v~r^-1 infall; compare against LIME fiducial disc
key_parameters: free parameters: central mass and disc radius
assumptions: Flat disc, n∝r^-1, T∝r^-0.5, LTE, optically thin, inclination 60 deg

recipe.method: RATRAN models with constant or jump abundance, power-law or flat inner density, compared to observed spectrum
key_parameters: r_100K ≈ 30 AU; centrifugal radius 100 AU assumed

evidence.quote: We find the radius of the spatially well-constrained disc to be 0.41$''$ which equals to 50 AU
corresponds to a central mass of $M_{\star}=2.3~M_{\odot}$ assuming the most probable inclination of $60\ensuremath{^\circ}$.
which corresponds to a disc mass of $0.024~M_{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Which spw/channels were line-free for continuum and the continuum bandwidth

score_reason: Data public and the recipe is simple, but many processing and modelling details are missing and fit uncertainties are not stated.
rediscovery_reason: Public Cycle 0 data, with numeric results (disc radius, stellar mass, disc mass) obtainable by a straightforward PV analysis.
